mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AIRCRAFT ( reg_no, model_name, total_seats, status_name, is_active ) VALUES ( #{reg_no}, #{model_name}, #{total_seats}, '운항가능', 'Y' )
mapper.select: SELECT aircraft_id, reg_no, model_name, total_seats, status_name, is_active FROM AIRCRAFT ORDER BY aircraft_id DESC
SELECT aircraft_id, reg_no, model_name, total_seats, status_name, is_active FROM AIRCRAFT WHERE aircraft_id = #{aircraft_id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FLIGHT WHERE aircraft_id = #{aircraft_id} AND is_deleted = 'N' AND arrival_time > SYSTIMESTAMP AND flight_status IN ( 'SCHEDULED', 'BOARDING', 'DEPARTED', 'DELAYED' )
SELECT aircraft_id, reg_no, model_name, total_seats, status_name, is_active FROM AIRCRAFT WHERE is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY model_name ASC, reg_no ASC
SELECT aircraft_id, reg_no, model_name, total_seats, status_name, is_active FROM AIRCRAFT WHERE aircraft_id = #{aircraft_id} AND is_active = 'Y'

SELECT SC.seat_class_id, SC.class_name, COUNT(S.seat_id) AS seat_count FROM SEAT S JOIN SEAT_CLASS SC ON S.seat_class_id = SC.seat_class_id WHERE S.aircraft_id = #{aircraft_id} AND S.is_active = 'Y' GROUP BY SC.seat_class_id, SC.class_name, SC.sort_order ORDER BY SC.sort_order ASC
